messages:
Marta Chen: Heads-up: Sales wants a special pricing exception for Pillar Health. They requested Net60 + a three-month onboarding credit at 18% applied to their first invoices. Deal size ~ $220k ARR, expected ramp $60k/mo. Need deal-desk + finance OK before legal drafts.
Liam O'Connor: Can we get specifics: exact credit calculation, whether credit is on invoice or as a separate credit memo, and requested customer payment instrument? Also, finance needs to know if this changes COGS recognition.
Sofia Ruiz: From the commercial thread: customer will sign a 12-month commitment if we offer Net60. They prefer PO for procurement cadence, can do ACH once PO is queued. They asked for the credit to be reflected on the first invoice not as a future refund.
Marta Chen: So current ask = Net60 + 18% one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice, contingent on 12-month minimum. Liam, any red flags on revenue recognition with credit-on-invoice?
Liam O'Connor: If credit reduces billed amount up front, ASC 606 guidance requires documenting contract modification. Finance ops: is applying a one-time invoice adjustment OK operationally? Also credit amount: 18% * 3 months at $60k/mo = $32.4k. That needs VP/CFO sign-off (> $30k).
deal-desk-bot: Logged exception request DD-20260322-087. Status: awaiting finance calc + exec approval.
Sofia Ruiz: Customer is flexible on credit months if it helps approval. We can move to 15% for the first 2 months to keep credit under $20k if that expedites signoff. I can push that in the negotiation.
Liam O'Connor: Finance preference: smaller credit with strict clawback if customer terminates early. Proposal: approve Net60 + 15% credit for first 2 months, conditional on: (1) signed 12-month commitment, (2) PO or ACH on file, (3) legal addendum with clawback and security annex, (4) VP finance ok for credit ~ $18k.
Marta Chen: Good alternative. Sofia, ask customer if they accept 15% x 2 months with the 12-month term and security addendum. Priors: include a line preventing similar concessions unless approved by deal desk.
Sofia Ruiz: On it. I'll confirm during tomorrow call. Also flagged to legal that we need a short amendment template.
finance-ops: Operational note: we can post a one-line invoice credit on first invoice. Need the deal desk ticket and signed addendum in contract system to apply. Tagging billing team for revenue recognition review.
Marta Chen: Thanks — I'll update the sales rep and re-open once Sofia confirms. If customer pushes back, we'll escalate to VP sales. :white_check_mark:
